disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. The Easy product page was thin on fetch, so accelerated categories remain incomplete.

joining.summary: The joining fee is ₹500. FD-backed Easy, Select, and Premier rows in the MITC list nil joining instead.

annual_waiver.summary: The joining fee is waived on ₹6,000 spend in the first 60 days. If that milestone is missed, the first-year fee is levied in the third statement. The annual fee is waived on ₹35,000 spend in the anniversary year. Waivers apply only for non-delinquent holders.

forex.summary: Foreign-currency markup is 3.5 percent of the transaction amount.

fuel_surcharge.summary: Fuel surcharge is waived at 1 percent on transactions from ₹400 to ₹5,000, capped at ₹250 per statement cycle. GST on surcharge is not reversed. No reward points apply on fuel.

conditions.summary: The waiver is capped at ₹250 per statement cycle.

base_earn.summary: The official page snippet states 1 point per ₹100 on other categories.

accelerated.summary: The product page advertises 5 reward points per ₹100 on movies, shopping, and utilities, capped at 1,000 reward points per statement cycle on those categories.

conditions.summary: Accelerated earn on those categories is capped at 1,000 reward points per statement cycle.

upi.notes: BOBCARD MITC does not describe a separate UPI earn rate for Easy.

redemption.summary: Cashback redemption is 1 reward point equals ₹0.20. Other catalogue options were not recovered without the Features and Rewards PDF.

expiry.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.
